[Isac Mari]
Grief for Greed...
There's a tale of an honest Merchant that lived in Morocc long ago who had a quarrel with a bad guild.
scripts.translation:
[伊薩克·馬裡]
破產之哀...
很久以前，在莫洛奇有一位誠實的商人，他與一個邪惡的公會發生了衝突。

scripts.text:
[Isac Mari]
Because the honest Merchant was not cheating people by his prices, his street stall was attacked by the bad guild and all his goods were taken.
scripts.translation:
[伊薩克·馬裡]
因為這位誠實的商人從不通過價格欺詐顧客，那個邪惡的公會襲擊了他的攤位，搶走了他所有的貨物。

scripts.text:
[Isac Mari]
So, the honest Merchant lost everything except some broken items. To express his sadness, he took these broken items and created this magnificent hat, the Grief for Greed.
scripts.translation:
[伊薩克·馬裡]
於是，這位誠實的商人失去了一切，只剩下一些破損的物品。為了表達他的悲傷，他用這些破損的物品製作了這頂華麗的帽子——“破產之哀”。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Isac Mari]
But can you check that the items in your inventory aren't upgraded or have cards compounded into them? If any of the required items have forged upgrades or cards, those will be lost once I create the Opera Masque.
scripts.translation:
[伊薩克·馬裡]
不過請檢查一下你背包裡的物品，確保它們沒有經過強化或鑲嵌卡片。如果任何所需物品帶有強化等級或卡片，一旦我製作出“舞會面具”，這些強化和卡片將會丟失。

scripts.text:
[Isac Mari]
It's better to keep only the items used to make the Opera Mask in your inventory. Did you check? If so, let's get started.
scripts.translation:
[伊薩克·馬裡]
最好只保留用於製作“舞會面具”的物品在背包中。你檢查過了嗎？如果沒問題，我們就開始吧。

scripts.text: Give me a minute~!
scripts.translation: 請稍等~！

scripts.text: Let's make the Opera Masque.
scripts.translation: 開始製作舞會面具

scripts.text:
[Isac Mari]
Alright. Please check your items again. It's much better to be safe than sorry.
scripts.translation:
[伊薩克·馬裡]
好的。請再次檢查你的物品。
小心駛得萬年船。

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Thook Thook*
*Pop!*^000000

[Isac Mari]
Whew! This is pretty hard!
scripts.translation:
[伊薩克·馬裡]
呼！這還挺難的！

scripts.text:
[Isac Mari]
I'm not quite sure if this is the right one.
But it looks fine. Ha ha
scripts.translation:
[伊薩克·馬裡]
我不太確定這是否就是正確的那一個。
但看起來還不錯。哈哈

scripts.text:
[Isac Mari]
Opera Phantom Mask...
Behind this mask is a story about a man's love and personal tragedy.
scripts.translation:
[伊薩克·馬裡]
歌劇之魂假面...
在這張面具背後，是一個關於男子的愛與個人悲劇的故事。

scripts.text:
[Isac Mari]
You may know him as the Phantom of the Opera. He was a musical genius that brought terror to the stage, because his scarred face forced him to live outside of society.
scripts.translation:
[伊薩克·馬裡]
你可能知道他被稱為“歌劇魅影”。他是一位音樂天才，卻在舞臺上帶來恐懼，因為他臉上的傷疤迫使他生活在社會之外。

scripts.text:
[Isac Mari]
However, he fell in love with a beautiful singer and used his talents to propel her to new heights of fame. He finally revealed himself to her.
scripts.translation:
[伊薩克·馬裡]
然而，他愛上了一位美麗的歌手，並運用他的才華將她推向名聲的新高峰。最終，他向她展示了自己真實的模樣。

scripts.text:
[Isac Mari]
In the end...
She deeply cared for him, but was in love with another singer. The Phantom disappeared, perhaps to haunt some other place, and all that was left of him was his mask...
scripts.translation:
[伊薩克·馬裡]
最後...
她深切地關心他，但愛著另一位歌手。魅影消失了，也許去縈繞在別處，而他留下的只有他的面具...

scripts.text:
[Isac Mari]
The mask that he was wearing is differently shaped that other opera masks, and was made to cover his particular facial scarring.
scripts.translation:
[伊薩克·馬裡]
他所戴的面具與其他歌劇面具形狀不同，是為了遮蓋他臉上特定的傷疤而製作的。

scripts.text:
[Isac Mari]
If you want to make Phantom of Opera. You will need:
^3355FF1 Opera Masque^000000
^3355FF50 Horrendous Hair^000000
scripts.translation:
[伊薩克·馬裡]
如果你想製作歌劇之魂假面，你需要：
^3355FF1 舞會面具^000000
^3355FF50 蛇發^000000

scripts.text:
[Isac Mari]
If you bring all the items then I will make it for you right away. See you later~
scripts.translation:
[伊薩克·馬裡]
如果你帶齊了所有物品，我會立刻為你製作。回見~

scripts.text:
[Rochito]
Bread, fruits, vegetables...
Bleh. All that other food is
nothing compared to the 
hearty flavor of meat. Yeap,
BBQ camping in Comodo is
heaven to a meat lover like me~
scripts.translation:
[羅奇托]
麵包、水果、蔬菜...
呸。比起那些，
肉的味道才叫實在。沒錯，
在克魔島燒烤露營，
對像我這樣的肉食愛好者來說簡直是天堂~

scripts.text: BBQ Camping...?
scripts.translation: 燒烤露營...？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Rochito]
Yeah man... You can eat
Komodoru meat all day when
you go BBQ camping. Komodoru
is an animal native to Comodo
and every part of it is delicious. Every. Single. Morsel.
scripts.translation:
[羅奇托]
是啊，夥計...去燒烤露營的話，
你可以整天吃科摩多龍肉。科摩多龍
是克魔島的原生物種，
它的每一部分都很美味。每一口。都。很。美。味。

scripts.text:
[Rochito]
What makes this meat even
more delicious is the special
Koserahserah seasoning they
use. That stuff is almost...
addictive. Without it, we
can't start our barbeque!
scripts.translation:
[羅奇托]
讓這肉更美味的，
是他們使用的特殊
Koserahserah調味料。那東西簡直...
讓人上癮。沒有它，
我們就沒法開始燒烤！

scripts.text:
[Rochito]
If we settled on anything
less than the very best BBQ,
then our comrades that died
to help ^FF0000banish that witch^000000 would
surely be ashamed of us!
scripts.translation:
[羅奇托]
如果我們吃的不是最好的燒烤，
那些為了^FF0000驅逐那個女巫^000000而犧牲的
同志們肯定會為我們感到羞恥！

scripts.text:
[Rochito]
Say, would you do us a favor?
The Chief of Comodo was going
to bring the Koserahserah and
join us for our barbeque, but
we're guessing he's got to
cancel because of his duties.
scripts.translation:
[羅奇托]
對了，能幫個忙嗎？
克魔島的首領本來打算帶著
Koserahserah來加入我們的燒烤，
但我們猜他因為公務
不得不取消了。

scripts.text:
[Rochito]
Let's see, our Chief lives to
the west of these campgrounds.
Would you visit him and see
what's taking him so long
to get over here?
scripts.translation:
[羅奇托]
讓我想想，我們的首領
住在這片營地的西邊。
你能去拜訪他一下，
看看他為什麼這麼久還沒過來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rochito]
You know, people gather
on these campgrounds in
memory and respect of those
that have fallen in battle
against the witch of Comodo.
scripts.translation:
[羅奇托]
你知道嗎，人們聚集
在這片營地，
是為了紀念和尊重那些
在與克魔島女巫的戰鬥中
犧牲的人。

scripts.text:
[Rochito]
Long before Comodo was
built inside this huge cave,
this witch used to live in here. A lot of people died trying to
get rid of her, but there're rumors that she's still around...
scripts.translation:
[羅奇托]
早在克魔島被建在這個巨大的洞穴裡之前，
這個女巫就住在這裡。很多人試圖
除掉她，但據說她還在附近...

scripts.text:
[Rochito]
Komodoru meat is especially
great when it's seasoned with
Koserahserah. That flavoring
is one of Comodo's claims to
fame! You should try some~
scripts.translation:
[羅奇托]
科摩多龍肉配上
Koserahserah特別好吃。那種調味料
是克魔島的著名特產！你應該嚐嚐~

scripts.text:
[Rochito]
Speaking of which, our Chief
still hasn't come and brought
the Koserahserah! Would you
see what's taking him so long?
His house is located west of
these campgrounds.
scripts.translation:
[羅奇托]
說到這個，我們的首領
還沒帶著Koserahserah來！你能
看看他為什麼這麼久還沒來嗎？
他的房子就在
這片營地的西邊。

scripts.text:
[Rochito]
Oh, hey, you're back.
Did you speak to our
Chief? Don't tell me
he had to cancel--we've
been planning this outing
with him for a quite a while...
scripts.translation:
[羅奇托]
哦，嘿，你回來了。
你和我們的首領
對話了嗎？別告訴我
他不得不取消——我們
和他計劃這次聚會
已經很久了...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou give Rochito the
Koserahserah seasoning,
and explain why the Chief
cannot attend the barbeque.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你把Koserahserah調味料
交給羅奇托，並解釋了
首領無法參加燒烤的原因。^000000

scripts.text:
[Rochito]
Awww, nuts. I guess he's
got responsbilities, but it's
still a little disappointing.
He's a buddy, after all. Well,
at least he was kind enough
to send the Koserahserah.
scripts.translation:
[羅奇托]
哎呀，真掃興。我想他
是有責任在身，但還是有點失望。
畢竟他是我們的夥伴。不過，
至少他好心地把Koserahserah送來了。

scripts.text:
[Rochito]
It's really too bad that
he can't join us. Ah, I've got
an idea! Would you please bring
this bottle to Tausupa, er, our
Chief? It's Mureuchieligu, a
special vintage wine~
scripts.translation:
[羅奇托]
他不能來真是太可惜了。啊，我有個主意！
你能把這瓶酒帶給陶蘇帕，呃，我們的
首領嗎？這是Mureuchieligu，
一種特製的美酒~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've received a bottle
of Mureuchieligu wine to
deliver to the Comodo Chief.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你收到了一瓶Mureuchieligu酒，
要帶給克魔島的首領。^000000

scripts.text:
[Rochito]
I know that I should be
delivering that bottle of
wine to the Chief myself,
but I've got to tend to this
barbeque. I hope you 
understand...
scripts.translation:
[羅奇托]
我知道我應該親自
把那瓶酒送給首領，
但我得照看這個燒烤。希望你
能理解...

scripts.text:
[Rochito]
Anyway, you'd be doing
me a huge favor if you
spoke to the Chief, and gave
him my thanks, along with
that bottle of Mureuchieligu.
scripts.translation:
[羅奇托]
總之，如果你能
幫我跟首領說一聲，
並轉達我的謝意，
連同那瓶Mureuchieligu，
那將幫了我大忙。

scripts.text:
[Rochito]
Oh, hey there~
Thanks for helping us
out earlier. I wish the
Chief would join us in our
barbeque, but I understand
that he has to protect Comodo.
scripts.translation:
[羅奇托]
哦，嘿~
謝謝你之前幫我們的忙。我希望
首領能加入我們的燒烤，但我理解
他必須保護克魔島。

scripts.text:
[Rochito]
Hey, you know what?
I can't exactly repay you
with, you know, actual stuff,
but I can give you a hot tip.
There's some guy at the local
Pub with some precious info.
scripts.translation:
[羅奇托]
嘿，你知道嗎？
我沒法用實際的物品來回報你，
但我可以給你一個有用的線索。
當地酒館裡有個人，
掌握著一些寶貴的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Rochito]
Yeah, supposedly, this
guy knows more about the
cave that Comodo was built
in... Anyway, I really get the
feeling that it just might
lead to something, you know?
scripts.translation:
[羅奇托]
是的，據說這個人
對科摩多龍所在的洞穴
瞭解更多...總之，我有一種感覺，
這可能會帶來一些發現，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rockha]
Oh man...
I'm so excited!
My buddies and I've
been planning to get
together for this barbeque
for such a long time~
scripts.translation:
[洛卡]
天哪...
我太興奮了！
我和巴迪們
計劃這次燒烤計劃了
好長時間~

scripts.text: Buddies...?
scripts.translation: 巴迪們...？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Rockha]
Yeah, some of us know
each other when we fought
together in the War of the
Witch. In fact, one of them
is the Chief of this village!
Huh, why isn't he here yet?
scripts.translation:
[洛卡]
是的，我們中的一些人
在女巫戰爭中一起戰鬥過。
事實上，其中一位
就是這個村莊的村長！
咦，他怎麼還沒來？

scripts.text:
[Rockha]
Anyway, even though
our stations in life have
changed, thankfully we're
still friends. It's kinda weird, though, being on a first name
basis with a village chief.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡]
總之，雖然
我們在生活中的地位
發生了變化，但幸運的是
我們仍然是朋友。不過，
和村長直呼其名
有點奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Rockha]
Makes me feel...
Important. I'm hobnobbing
with a major political figure,
after all. Amazing where your
friends can end up in life...
scripts.translation:
[洛卡]
這讓我覺得...
很重要。畢竟，
我在和一位重要的政治人物
交往。真不敢相信
朋友在人生中能走到哪裡...

scripts.text:
[Rockha]
I've almost forgotten
how much I love hanging
out with these guys. We
should have barbeques
together all the time~
scripts.translation:
[洛卡]
我幾乎忘記了
和這些人在一起
是多麼快樂。我們應該
經常一起燒烤~

scripts.text:
[Rockha]
Wha--? Tausupa can't come,
but he still sent us all of this Koserahserah? What a guy...
I guess... That gives us
a reason to hold another
barbeque here soon, right?
scripts.translation:
[洛卡]
什--？陶蘇帕不能來，
但他還是給我們寄了
這麼多Koserahserah？真是個好人...
我想...這給了我們
很快再舉辦一次
燒烤的理由，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Rockha]
Hey, when you deliver
that wine to Tausupa, the
Village Chief, would you let
him know that we miss the guy?
He may be busy, but he'll always be our irreplaceable buddy.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡]
嘿，當你把
那瓶酒送給陶蘇帕，
村長時，能幫我
告訴他我們想念他嗎？
他可能很忙，但他
永遠是我們不可替代的巴迪。

scripts.text:
[Rockha]
Oh hey, you spoke
to Tausupa? Ah, it's
too bad that he's busy,
but it's great to hear that
he'll enjoy our gift. Okay~
I believe it's time to eat!
scripts.translation:
[洛卡]
哦，嘿，你
和陶蘇帕說話了？啊，
真遺憾他太忙了，
但很高興聽到
他會喜歡我們的禮物。好的~
我想是時候開吃了！

scripts.text:
[Rockha]
But before that, let's
make a toast... to Tausupa!
Guardian of Comodo, and
one of the best friends that
a guy can have! Cheers!
Hahahaha hahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[洛卡]
但在那之前，讓我們
舉杯...為了陶蘇帕！
克魔島的守護者，
以及一個男人能擁有的
最好的朋友之一！乾杯！
哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Rockha]
Ahh, you know what would
make this meal perfect?
Some of that legendary
^3355FFComodo Cheese^000000 that I heard
about from ^3355FFToruna^000000. Sure, it
might not exist, but still...!
scripts.translation:
[洛卡]
啊，你知道什麼
能讓這頓飯完美嗎？
一些傳說中的
^3355FF克魔島乳酪^000000，
我從^3355FF托魯娜^000000那裡聽說的。
當然，
它可能不存在，但還是...！

scripts.text:
[Rockha]
You know, you're a really
chill person. Thanks for
helping us keep in touch
with our old friend, the
Village Chief. Man, being
responsible must be rough...
scripts.translation:
[洛卡]
你知道嗎，你真的是
一個很隨和的人。謝謝你
幫助我們保持
與老朋友，
村長的聯絡。天哪，
負責任一定很艱難...

scripts.text:
[Rockha]
There's two things that
would make our barbeque
absolutely perfect--having
the Village Chief here, and
some of that legendary Comodo Cheese that ^3355FFToruna^000000 told me about.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡]
有兩件事
能讓我們的燒烤
絕對完美——村長在這裡，
以及^3355FF托魯娜^000000告訴我的
一些傳說中的克魔島乳酪。

scripts.text:
[Emralhandas]
Rockha, let me pour
you another drink. We
always dreamed of this
during the War of the Witch...
Having a good time, all of us
together in a time of peace~
scripts.translation:
[埃姆拉爾漢達斯]
洛卡，讓我
再給你倒一杯。我們
在女巫戰爭中
一直夢想著這一刻...
在和平時期，
大家在一起盡興~

scripts.text: War of the Witch?
scripts.translation: 女巫戰爭？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Emralhandas]
Before I tell you about the
War of the Witch, I guess
I should tell you about the
quest to retrieve 4 rare swords
of power, said to be the most
powerful weapons ever made.
scripts.translation:
[埃姆拉爾漢達斯]
在我告訴你
女巫戰爭之前，我想
我應該先告訴你
關於尋找4把稀有力量之劍的任務，
據說它們是最強大的武器。

scripts.text:
[Emralhandas]
Now, all 4 swords were
successfully found 10 years
after the search began. Then,
4 protectors were chosen to
ensure that the swords did
not fall into the wrong hands.
scripts.translation:
[埃姆拉爾漢達斯]
現在，所有4把劍
在搜尋開始10年後
都被成功找到了。然後，
4位守護者被選中，
以確保這些劍
不會落入錯誤的手中。

scripts.text:
[Emralhandas]
You might not think so just
by looking at us, but we were
the protectors--me, Rockha,
Rochito, and Tausupa, the chief
of this village. Now, we guarded these weapons very carefully...
scripts.translation:
[埃姆拉爾漢達斯]
你可能不會
通過看我們這樣想，但我們
是守護者——我，洛卡，
羅奇托，和這個村莊的村長陶蘇帕。
現在，我們非常小心地
守護著這些武器...

scripts.text:
[Emralhandas]
However, that didn't deter
Mariposum, ancient witch of
Comodo, from attacking us and
trying to steal the swords. She
was incredibly powerful, and
we needed an army to fight her.
scripts.translation:
[埃姆拉爾漢達斯]
然而，這並沒有阻止克魔島的古代女巫瑪裡波蘇姆。她襲擊了我們，並試圖偷走那些劍。她的力量極其強大，我們需要一支軍隊才能與她對抗。

scripts.text:
[Emralhandas]
That was the War of the
Witch, basically. Mariposum
with her own strange weapon
of mass destruction against the
four of us backed by a large
force of courageous soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[埃姆拉爾漢達斯]
那基本上就是女巫戰爭。瑪裡波蘇姆帶著她那奇怪的毀滅性武器，對抗著我們四人以及背後支援的大量勇敢士兵。

scripts.text:
[Emralhandas]
Many of our comrades died...
But finally we succeeded in
imprisoning the witch by using
the power of the swords. Yeah,
if it weren't for Tausupa, we'd
never have been able to do it.
scripts.translation:
[埃姆拉爾漢達斯]
許多同志犧牲了...
但最終，我們利用劍的力量成功將女巫封印了。是啊，如果沒有陶蘇帕，我們根本做不到。

scripts.text:
[Emralhandas]
Rockha, we still have
to finish our mission:
eat all of the barbeque
that that we possibly can!
Let's just stuff ourselves...
All the way until tommorrow!
scripts.translation:
[埃姆拉爾漢達斯]
洛卡，我們還得完成我們的任務：
儘可能多地吃掉所有燒烤！
讓我們盡情吃吧...
一直吃到明天！

scripts.text:
[Rotute]
Years ago, there was a huge
quest to retrieve 4 rare swords
of incredible power, supposedly
the strongest swords ever made!
But you know, there's a strange
rumor about a secret 5th sword.
scripts.translation:
[羅圖特]
多年前，有一個巨大的任務，要找回4把擁有不可思議力量的稀有之劍，據說它們是有史以來最強大的劍！
但你知道嗎，關於一把秘密的第5把劍，有一個奇怪的傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Rotute]
This 5th sword is supposed
to be hidden near Glastheim.
If it does exist, it might have
the power to change the world!
Isn't that freakin' scary?
scripts.translation:
[羅圖特]
據說這把第5把劍隱藏在葛拉斯特海姆附近。
如果它真的存在，它可能擁有改變世界的力量！
這不是很可怕嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rotute]
Hey, isn't that Koserahserah?
That's the best seasoning that
you can have for meat dishes!
Oh, you got that from the Chief
to give to Rochito? Wow, they
must be really good friends...
scripts.translation:
[羅圖特]
嘿，那不是可塞拉塞拉嗎？
那是肉菜最好的調味料！
哦，那是村長給你給羅奇托的嗎？哇，他們一定是好朋友...

scripts.text:
[Rotute]
Hello, thanks for helping
out Rockha, Rochito and
Emralhandas. They've known
me since I was born, so it's
like they're family to me.
scripts.translation:
[羅圖特]
你好，謝謝你幫助洛卡、羅奇托和埃姆拉爾漢達斯。他們從我出生起就認識我了，所以對我來說他們就像家人一樣。

scripts.text:
[Rotute]
One of the reasons that
they brought me here to
Comodo was so that I could
finally meet Tausupa. But...
I guess he's too busy now.
Still, I like this place!
scripts.translation:
[羅圖特]
他們把我帶到克魔島的原因之一，就是讓我終於能見到陶蘇帕。但是...
我想他現在太忙了。
不過，我喜歡這個地方！

scripts.text:
[Rinta]
I didn't mean to,
but I accidentally
eavesdropped on those
people over there. Are
they really old friends
with our Village Chief?
scripts.translation:
[琳塔]
我不是故意的，
但我無意中聽到了
那邊那些人的談話。
他們真的是
我們村長的老朋友嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rinta]
In that case, they must
be getting the special
treatment usually reserved
for visiting dignitaries and
the like. Or something like that.
scripts.translation:
[琳塔]
如果是那樣的話，他們一定
受到了通常只留給
貴賓之類的特殊待遇。
或者類似的東西。

scripts.text:
[Razy]
Those people over there
are friends of the Village
Chief? I was wondering about
them for the longest time...
I didn't even know our Chief
had friends outside of Comodo.
scripts.translation:
[拉齊]
那邊那些人是
村長的朋友？我好奇
他們很久了...
我甚至不知道
我們的村長在克魔島之外
還有朋友。

scripts.text:
[Razy]
You know, they kind of
strike me as old war buddies,
sprinkling their conversations
with words like ''mission'' all
the time. Then, there's those
little scars they all have...
scripts.translation:
[拉齊]
你知道嗎，他們
給我的感覺像是
老戰友，
談話中總是
夾雜著“任務”之類的詞。
然後，他們身上
都有那些小傷疤...

scripts.text:
[BBQ Boy]
D-daddy! Is what those
people talking about true?
Was there really an evil
witch here in our village?
scripts.translation:
[燒烤男孩]
爸...爸爸！
那些人說的
是真的嗎？
我們村子裡
真的有邪惡的女巫嗎？

scripts.text:
[BBQ Mama]
Honey...
I'm sure those
good people were
just kidding around~
How can that be true?
scripts.translation:
[燒烤大媽]
親愛的...
我確信那些
好人只是在
開玩笑~
那怎麼可能
是真的呢？

scripts.text:
[BBQ Papa]
Now, now, don't tell
me my little man is afraid
of something like a little
witch. It's just an old fairy
tale, son: no reason to
feel frightened at all.
scripts.translation:
[燒烤大叔]
好了，好了，別告訴我
我的小男子漢
害怕一個小女巫。
那只是一個老童話，
兒子：完全沒必要
感到害怕。

scripts.text:
[BBQ Boy]
No, Daddy, I'm not
scared! But if the witch
really lived here, then her
home is somewhere around
here in Comodo, right? I'm
gonna go find it someday!
scripts.translation:
[燒烤男孩]
不，爸爸，我不
害怕！但如果女巫
真的住在這裡，
那麼她的家
就在克魔島附近，對吧？
我總有一天
會找到它的！

scripts.text:
[BBQ Mama]
Oh, but I'm sure our
Chief would already know
something about that witch
if she truly exists. Anyway,
let's hurry and eat before
the barbeque burns, okay?
scripts.translation:
[燒烤大媽]
哦，但我確信
如果那個女巫
真的存在，
我們的村長
早就知道了。總之，
我們快點吃吧，
別讓燒烤燒焦了，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[BBQ Boy]
Yay, barbeque!
Mmmmm... Someday,
if that witch is real,
I'm gonna find out
all about her!
scripts.translation:
[燒烤男孩]
耶，燒烤！
嗯...總有一天，
如果那個女巫
是真的，
我要弄清楚
關於她的一切！

scripts.text:
[Tausupa]
Maybe you can't tell because
of the way the light reflects,
but Comodo is actually built
inside a huge cave, giving the
illusion of an eternal night.
It's quite beautiful, really...
scripts.translation:
[陶蘇帕]
也許因為光線反射的方式，
你看不出來，
但克魔島實際上是
建在一個巨大的洞穴裡，
給人一種永恆夜晚的錯覺。
真的很美...

scripts.text:
[Tausupa]
People come from all over
the world to experience the
excitement and beauty of
our unique little village.
We've become quite
the tourist attraction~
scripts.translation:
[陶蘇帕]
來自世界各地的人們
都來到我們這獨特的小村莊，
體驗這裡的刺激與美景。
我們可是相當有名的
旅遊勝地呢~

scripts.text:
[Tausupa]
Oh, how are my friends
doing? I really wish that
I could have delivered that
Koserahserah personally,
but I can't shirk my duties as
Village Chief and protector.
scripts.translation:
[陶蘇帕]
啊，不知道我的朋友們
過得怎麼樣？我真希望能親手
把那瓶Koserahserah送過去，
但我不能推卸作為村長
和守護者的職責。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou give Tausupa the
Meruchieligu wine that
Rochito asked you to deliver.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你將羅奇托讓你轉交的
Meruchieligu酒交給了陶蘇帕。^000000

scripts.text:
[Tausupa]
Ah... How very kind of
them! They really sent me
this wine? I'm truly touched...
Rockha must have chosen
this--I'll be sure to enjoy it.
scripts.translation:
[陶蘇帕]
啊……他們真是太好了！
真的給我寄了這瓶酒嗎？
我真的很感動……
這一定是洛卡挑的——
我一定會好好享受的。

scripts.text:
[Tausupa]
Would you please express my
thanks to my friends, ^3355FFRochito^000000,
and ^3355FFRockha^000000? It's been far too
long since I've seen them, but
I hope that I get a chance to
visit them someday soon.
scripts.translation:
[陶蘇帕]
請幫我向我的朋友們，
^3355FF羅奇托^000000和
^3355FF洛卡^000000轉達我的謝意。
我已經很久沒見到他們了，
希望不久後能有機會
去拜訪他們。

scripts.text:
[Tausupa]
Would you please express my
thanks to my friends, ^3355FFRochito^000000,
and ^3355FFRockha^000000? It's been far too
long since I've seen them, but
I hope that I get a chance to
visit them someday soon.
scripts.translation:
[陶蘇帕]
請幫我向我的朋友們，
^3355FF羅奇托^000000和
^3355FF洛卡^000000轉達我的謝意。
我已經很久沒見到他們了，
希望不久後能有機會
去拜訪他們。

scripts.text:
[Tausupa]
Greetings, adventurer,
I am Tausupa, the Chief of
Comodo, a city famous for its beauty and nightlife. I hope you
enjoy your stay, whether you are seeking excitement or relaxation~
scripts.translation:
[陶蘇帕]
你好，冒險者，
我是陶蘇帕，克魔島的村長。
克魔島以美景和夜生活聞名。
無論你是在尋找刺激還是放鬆，
都希望你在這裡度過愉快的時光~

scripts.text: About Casino
scripts.translation: 關於賭場

scripts.text: About Banished Witch
scripts.translation: 關於被放逐的女巫

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Tausupa]
Ah yes, Comodo is world
famous for its Casino. There
are many games that you can
enjoy, but you'll need to use
the Casino's special Eulwo currency and conversion system...
scripts.translation:
[陶蘇帕]
啊，是的，克魔島以賭場聞名於世。
那裡有很多你可以享受的遊戲，
不過你需要使用賭場專用的
Eulwo貨幣和兌換系統……

scripts.text:
[Tausupa]
Banished witch...?
Ah ha ha, do not worry,
my friend, that is merely
a very old tale. Not worth
your concern at all...
scripts.translation:
[陶蘇帕]
被放逐的女巫……？
啊哈哈，別擔心，
我的朋友，那只是一個
非常古老的故事而已。
完全不值得你擔心……

scripts.text:
[Tausupa]
Ah, judging from the scent
of BBQ meat on your clothes,
I'm guessing that you ran into
Rochito in the campgrounds, 
right? He must have told you that old story about the witch...
scripts.translation:
[陶蘇帕]
啊，看你衣服上
燒烤肉的味道，
我猜你是在露營地
遇到了羅奇托吧？
他一定是給你講了
那個關於女巫的舊故事……

scripts.text:
[Tausupa]
I'd like nothing better
than to join them, but I must
stay here. The witch does exist, and one my jobs is to make sure
that she does not revive by using my sword's power to suppress her.
scripts.translation:
[陶蘇帕]
我本想和他們一起，
但我必須留在這裡。
女巫確實存在，而我的職責之一
就是利用我的劍的力量壓制她，
確保她不會復活。

scripts.text:
[Tausupa]
Although I planned to see
them today, my duties must
take priority. Would you please
take this seasoning to Rochito
and let him know that I can't
come, and that I'm sorry...?
scripts.translation:
[陶蘇帕]
雖然我原本計劃今天去看他們，
但職責必須放在首位。
請你把這個調味料帶給羅奇托，
告訴他我過不去了，
並讓他知道我很抱歉……？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have received
the Koserahserah
seasoning from the Chief.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你從村長那裡收到了
Koserahserah調味料。^000000

scripts.text:
[Tausupa]
Thank you so much...
I understand that my
friends cannot begin the
barbeque without Comodo's
world famous seasoning...
scripts.translation:
[陶蘇帕]
非常感謝……
我知道如果沒有克魔島
世界聞名的調味料，
我的朋友們就沒法開始燒烤……

scripts.text:
[Tausupa]
Please take this special
Koserserah seasoning to
my friend ^3355FFRochito^000000 at the
barbeque campground. Thanks
again for your help, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[陶蘇帕]
請把這個特別的
Koserserah調味料帶給
在燒烤露營地的我的朋友
^3355FF羅奇托^000000。
再次感謝你的幫助，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Tausupa]
Maybe you can't tell because
of the way the light reflects,
but Comodo is actually built
inside a huge cave, giving the
illusion of an eternal night.
It's quite beautiful, really...
scripts.translation:
[陶蘇帕]
也許因為光線反射的方式，
你看不出來，
但克魔島實際上是
建在一個巨大的洞穴裡，
給人一種永恆夜晚的錯覺。
真的很美...

scripts.text:
[Tausupa]
People come from all over
the world to experience the
excitement and beauty of
our unique little village.
We've become quite
the tourist attraction~
scripts.translation:
[陶蘇帕]
來自世界各地的人們
都來到我們這獨特的小村莊，
體驗這裡的刺激與美景。
我們可是相當有名的
旅遊勝地呢~

scripts.text:
[Toruna]
When I think about it,
there are many fascinating
facts about Comodo. Can
you believe this entire city
is built inside a natural cave?
scripts.translation:
[托魯娜]
仔細想想，
克魔島有很多迷人的事實。
你能相信這整座城市
都建在一個天然洞穴裡嗎？

scripts.text: This cave is huge!
scripts.translation: 這個洞穴好大！

scripts.text: This place sure is strange...
scripts.translation: 這個地方真奇怪……

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Toruna]
Oh, this is a huge cave,
but it's not impossible for
nature to create something
of this size and scale if given
thousands, maybe even millions
of years. Let me explain...
scripts.translation:
[托魯娜]
哦，這確實是個巨大的洞穴，
但如果給大自然幾千，
甚至幾百萬年的時間，
創造出如此規模和尺寸的東西
也並非不可能。讓我解釋一下……

scripts.text:
[Toruna]
Now, water is known as
a universal solvent: running
water will carve its own path
in rock, given enough time.
Now, keep in mind that this
cave was once solid limestone.
scripts.translation:
[托魯娜]
水被稱為萬能溶劑：
只要時間足夠，
流動的水就能在岩石中
開闢出自己的道路。
請記住，
這個洞穴曾經是一整塊
堅實的石灰岩。

scripts.text:
[Toruna]
Years and years of running
water from the rains and the
water table have broken down
this giant pocket of limestone,
clearing out this huge, open
area, the Comodo Cave.
scripts.translation:
[托魯娜]
年復一年，
雨水和地下水不斷沖刷，
逐漸瓦解了這塊巨大的石灰岩，
最終形成了這片開闊的空間，
也就是克魔島洞穴。

scripts.text:
[Toruna]
That may sound incredulous,
but cracks in limestone grow
into faults, then spacious gaps
over years and years of erosion. Now, isn't natural science just
amazing? You've got to agree...
scripts.translation:
[托魯娜]
這聽起來可能難以置信，
但石灰岩上的裂縫會隨時間
演變成斷層，
再經過漫長的侵蝕，
最終形成寬敞的空隙。
自然科學是不是很神奇？
你不得不承認...

scripts.text:
[Toruna]
Yes, that is rather
peculiar. What's also
strange is this rumor I've
been hearing about. Now, are you familiar with Comodo Cheese?
scripts.translation:
[托魯娜]
是的，這確實有些
特別。更奇怪的是
我最近聽到的一個傳聞。
你聽說過克魔島乳酪嗎？

scripts.text:
[Toruna]
It's this urban legend
about this magnificent cheese
that you can only find in Comodo. Now, not too many people believe
it. I mean, you need goats or cows
in order to make any cheese.
scripts.translation:
[托魯娜]
這是一個都市傳說，
關於一種只能在克魔島
找到的美味乳酪。
不過，相信的人並不多。
畢竟，製作乳酪
需要山羊或奶牛。

scripts.text:
[Toruna]
However, there's this
strange man that insists
on its existence. The locals
here chalk him up to be some
sort of common loon, but who
knows? Maybe it does exist...
scripts.translation:
[托魯娜]
然而，這裡有個奇怪的男子
堅持說它存在。
當地人只把他當成
一個普通的瘋子，
但誰知道呢？
也許它真的存在...

scripts.text:
[Toruna]
Well, you can decide for
yourself whether he's off
his rocker. The last time
I saw him, he was in the
Comodo Bar, so you can
probably find him there.
scripts.translation:
[托魯娜]
你可以自己去判斷
他是不是瘋了。
我上次見到他時，
他還在克魔島酒吧，
所以你應該能在那裡找到他。

scripts.text:
[Toruna]
Well, I like to think of
Comodo as unique. What's
really strange are some of
the locals in this area. I've
already told you about the
man in the Comodo Bar, yes?
scripts.translation:
[托魯娜]
我覺得克魔島很獨特。
真正奇怪的是
這裡的某些當地人。
我已經跟你提過
克魔島酒吧裡的那個男人了，
對吧？

scripts.text:
[Toruna]
He keeps insisting
that there is a special
kind of cheese in Comodo
that you cannot get anywhere
else. It sounds crazy, but his
claim may be worth verifying...
scripts.translation:
[托魯娜]
他堅持說克魔島有一種
特殊的乳酪，
別的地方都買不到。
聽起來很瘋狂，
但他的說法也許值得驗證...

scripts.text:
[Toruna]
Ah, did you know that
before it was an exotic
village of excitement and
leisure, Comodo was once
a haven for evil creatures, ruled by a witch named Meropusum?
scripts.translation:
[托魯娜]
你知道嗎？
在克魔島成為充滿激情
與休閒的異國村莊之前，
它曾是邪惡生物的避難所，
由一位名叫梅羅普蘇姆的女巫統治。

scripts.text:
[Toruna]
This witch lay dormant for
years until she was awoken
somehow years ago. She was
a huge threat to the people, but then she was finally defeated
in the famous War of the Witch.
scripts.translation:
[托魯娜]
這位女巫沉睡多年，
直到幾年前不知為何被喚醒。
她對人們構成了巨大威脅，
但最終在著名的女巫之戰中
被擊敗了。

scripts.text:
[Toruna]
One of the heroes of that
war became the current Chief
of this village, and it was
through his leadership that
Comodo grew into a thriving
tourist attraction.
scripts.translation:
[托魯娜]
那場戰爭的英雄之一
成為了這裡的首領，
在他的領導下，
克魔島發展成了
一個繁榮的旅遊勝地。

scripts.text:
[Toruna]
However, the threat of
Meropusum still exists,
so I would be careful when
exploring the uninhabited
areas of the Comodo region.
scripts.translation:
[托魯娜]
然而，梅羅普蘇姆的威脅
依然存在，
所以探索克魔島地區
無人居住的地方時，
請務必小心。

scripts.text:
[Toruna]
There's much to do
in this city of Comodo,
as well as much to learn
about it. I can never tire of
visiting this exotic city...
scripts.translation:
[托魯娜]
在克魔島這座城裡，
有很多事可以做，
也有很多事可以瞭解。
我永遠不會厭倦
造訪這座異國城市...

scripts.text:
[Rakusa]
See that guy sitting
over there? All he does
is talk about Comodo Cheese,
just mumbling nonsense about
its incredible flavors all day
long. He's nuts, I tell you.
scripts.translation:
[拉庫薩]
看到那邊坐著的那個人了嗎？
他整天除了談論克魔島乳酪，
就只會胡言亂語，
吹噓它的美味。
我告訴你，他瘋了。

scripts.text:
[Rakusa]
First of all, you need
freakin' milk to make any
cheese. You see any cows
around here? Nope, I thought
so! Still, I think he really
believes that it exists...
scripts.translation:
[拉庫薩]
首先，做乳酪
得用牛奶才行。你看到附近有
奶牛了嗎？沒有吧！
我就知道！不過，我覺得
他是真心相信它存在的...

scripts.text:
[Rakusa]
Damn it! I know for a fact
that the idea of Comodo even
having a cheese is crazy, but
that guy's talking has gotten
me curious now! Maybe it does
exist? How would it even taste?
scripts.translation:
[拉庫薩]
該死！我確信克魔島
有乳酪這種說法很荒謬，
但那個傢伙的話
讓我現在有點好奇了！
也許它真的存在？
它嚐起來會是什麼味道？

scripts.text:
[Rakusa]
You know, Comodo has
a reputation for offering
high class recreation, so
people forget that we actually
have two dangerous dungeons.
scripts.translation:
[拉庫薩]
你知道嗎，克魔島以提供
高階娛樂而聞名，
所以人們往往忘記
我們這裡其實有兩個
危險的地下城。

scripts.text:
[Rakusa]
You adventurers need to
be extra careful if you explore
the caves--the monsters there
are unusually strong. Make
sure that you're well prepared
before you even think of going!
scripts.translation:
[拉庫薩]
冒險者們在探索洞穴時
需要格外小心——
那裡的魔物異常強大。
在考慮前往之前，
務必做好充分準備！

scripts.text:
[Kichiri]
Freakin' ^3355FFMagatu^000000...!
Can he talk about anything else
aside from Comodo Cheese?
I don't see why he's so excited
about the stuff! Everyone knows
it's just an old wive's tale.
scripts.translation:
[基奇裡]
該死的^3355FF馬加圖^000000...
除了克魔島乳酪，
他還能說點別的嗎？
我不明白他為什麼
對那東西這麼興奮！
大家都知道那只是
一個老掉牙的傳說。

scripts.text:
[Kichiri]
Would you do
me a favor and get
Magatu to shut up?
I just want to drink
my alcohol in peace!
scripts.translation:
[基奇裡]
你能不能幫我個忙，
讓馬加圖閉嘴？
我只想安安靜靜地喝酒！

scripts.text:
[Kichiri]
Cripes! Now Magatu's
got me wondering! I mean,
just because I've never seen
Comodo Cheese doesn't mean
it doesn't exist, right? Curses! Now I'm thinking about it too!
scripts.translation:
[基奇裡]
天哪！現在馬加圖讓我開始懷疑了！
我是說，
雖然我從未見過克魔島乳酪，
但這並不意味著它不存在，對吧？
該死！現在我也開始胡思亂想了！

scripts.text:
[Kichiri]
There's more to do than
gambling in Comodo, you
know. Sometimes, I love
to watch the Dancers on
stage in the middle of the
village. They're so glamorous~
scripts.translation:
[基奇裡]
在克魔島，
除了賭博還有很多事可做。
有時候，我喜歡看村莊中央
舞臺上的舞娘表演。
她們真是光彩照人~

scripts.text:
[Kichiri]
I hear that the Dance
Academy only accepts female
Archers to become prospective
Dancers. I guess that makes
sense--they're tone and fit,
but not musclebound either...
scripts.translation:
[基奇裡]
我聽說舞蹈學院
只招收女性弓箭手
作為舞娘的候選人。
我想這很合理——
她們身材勻稱，
既苗條又健美，
但不會肌肉發達...

scripts.text:
[Magatu]
Comodo Cheese...
It really exists...!
And I'm so close to
having the proof! Oh...
That look in your eyes...
Y-you really believe me!
scripts.translation:
[馬加圖]
克魔島乳酪...
它真的存在...！
而且我馬上就要
拿到證據了！哦...
你眼中的那種神情...
你...你真的相信我！

scripts.text:
[Magatu]
At long last, not only
someone who believes me,
but an adventurer to boot!
Great, this is perfect! Now,
listen, you want to learn more
about Comodo Cheese, right?
scripts.translation:
[馬加圖]
終於，不僅有人相信我，
還是個冒險者！
太好了，這太完美了！
聽著，你想了解更多
關於克魔島乳酪的事情，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Magatu]
Well, I happen to know
someone who knows someone
that might be able to give you
the chance to try it for yourself! His name is ^3355FFManzi^000000 , and you can
find him in Comodo's Casino.
scripts.translation:
[馬加圖]
巧的是，我認識一個人，
他認識另一個人，
也許能讓你有機會親自嚐嚐！
他叫^3355FF曼齊^000000，
你可以在克魔島的賭場找到他。

scripts.text:
[Magatu]
Oh, here, before I forget,
take my lucky bottle cap!
Show this to Manzi, and he'll
know that I sent you, and that
you want to learn more about
the elusive Comodo Cheese.
scripts.translation:
[馬加圖]
哦，對了，趁我沒忘，
拿著我的幸運瓶蓋！
把這個給曼齊看，
他就會知道是我派你來的，
而且你想了解更多
關於[狡猾]科摩多龍乳酪的事。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have received
Magatu's lucky bottle
cap to present to Manzi.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你獲得了
馬加圖的幸運瓶蓋，
用於出示給曼齊。

scripts.text:
[Magatu]
Oh, don't forget to
show my lucky bottle cap
to Manzi, okay? You can find
him inside Comodo's Casino~
Good luck, and I hope you get
to try that Comodo Cheese~
scripts.translation:
[馬加圖]
哦，別忘了
把我的幸運瓶蓋
給曼齊看，好嗎？
你可以在克魔島的賭場裡找到他~
祝你好運，希望你能嚐到
那款克魔島乳酪~

scripts.text:
[Magatu]
It's true, it really
exists... Comodo Cheese!
Its flavor must be incomparably
delicious if adventurers have
quested to obtain it for so
many generations...
scripts.translation:
[馬加圖]
是真的，它真的存在...
克魔島乳酪！
既然冒險者們
世世代代都在尋找它，
那它的味道一定
無與倫比地美味...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse, but I'm
looking for someone
named Manzi. Do you
know where I can find him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，我在找
一個叫曼齊的人。
你知道我在哪裡能找到他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Manzi]
Hey guy, I'm right here.
So what exactly do you
want? I'm, um, not in
trouble or anything, am I?
scripts.translation:
[曼齊]
嘿，夥計，我就在這兒。
你到底想要什麼？
我，呃，沒有惹上麻煩吧？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou give Manzi the
lucky bottle cap that you
received from Magatsu.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你把從馬加圖那裡獲得的
幸運瓶蓋交給了曼齊。^000000

scripts.text:
[Manzi]
Whoa, Magatsu gave you
this? Ah, okay, so you must
be looking for that Comodo
Cheese he keeps talking about.
Alright, I owe him a favor, so
I'll tell you who to talk to...
scripts.translation:
[曼齊]
哇，馬加圖給你的？
啊，好吧，那你一定是來找
他一直在唸叨的那個克魔島乳酪的。
好吧，我欠他人情，
所以我會告訴你該找誰...

scripts.text:
[Manzi]
From the Casino, go north
towards the center of the
village, and then look to
the right where you'll see
the Dance Stage. You'll see
this old woman right there.
scripts.translation:
[曼齊]
從賭場出發，
向北走向村莊中心，
然後看右邊，
你會看到舞蹈舞臺。
你會看到那位老婦人就在那裡。

scripts.text:
[Manzi]
Don't be fooled by the
way she looks--that old
lady is one of Comodo's
wisest elders. Ask her
about the cheese, and
let her know I sent you~
scripts.translation:
[曼齊]
別被她外表騙了——
那位老婦人是克魔島
最智慧的長老之一。
問問她關於乳酪的事，
並告訴她是我派你來的~

scripts.text:
[Manzi]
Ah, she won't take you
very seriously unless you
show her this. Magatsu gave
you his lucky bottle cap, so I'm gonna give you my lucky coin!
The old crone'll recognize it~
scripts.translation:
[曼齊]
啊，除非你給她看這個，
否則她不會太重視你。
馬加圖給了你他的幸運瓶蓋，
所以我要把我的幸運硬幣給你！
那個老太婆會認出來的~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received Manzi's
''lucky coin.'' Strangely
enough, both sides
are heads.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你收到了曼齊的
“幸運硬幣”。
奇怪的是，
硬幣的兩面都是正面。

scripts.text:
[Manzi]
Look for the old crone
near the Dance Stage here
in Comodo and ask her about
Comodo Cheese, alright? Ah,
and try not to insult her, kay?
It'll make me look bad~
scripts.translation:
[曼齊]
在克魔島這裡，
去舞蹈舞臺附近找那個老太婆，
問問她關於克魔島乳酪的事，好嗎？
啊，還有，儘量別冒犯她，好嗎？
否則我會很沒面子的~

scripts.text:
[Manzi]
What th...?
What's a kid like
you doing in a Casino?
Sure, it's not against the
rules, but I think you oughta
scram and play somewhere else!
scripts.translation:
[曼齊]
什...什麼？
像你這樣的小孩
在賭場做什麼？
雖然這不違反規定，
但我認為你應該滾去
別的地方玩！

scripts.text:
[Manzi]
Hey, have a good time in
the Casino, but don't go buck
wild. You wanna walk out of
here with the shirt on your back, you know? Some people don't
even leave here with that...
scripts.translation:
[曼齊]
嘿，在賭場玩得開心點，
但別太瘋狂。
你想穿著衣服走出這裡，對吧？
有些人甚至連衣服都留不下...

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
Hula~hula~hula~
Love togther, love together,
we've groovin' on some more~
Love togther, love together,
we've living on the floor~
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
呼啦~呼啦~呼啦~
愛在一起，愛在一起，
我們繼續搖擺~
愛在一起，愛在一起，
我們在地板上生活~

scripts.text: Present Muzi's Coin
scripts.translation: 出示曼齊的硬幣

scripts.text: Um... Comodo Cheese?
scripts.translation: 嗯...克魔島乳酪？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou present Muzi's lucky
coin to the old woman.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你向老婦人出示了曼齊的幸運硬幣。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
Love! Love!
Love together~
Love! Love!
Love togeth-hm?
Oh, that's um, Muzi's
cheat coin, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
愛！愛！
愛在一起~
愛！愛！
愛在一-嗯？
哦，那是曼齊的
作弊硬幣，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
He always said that he
might send someone with
that coin to me as a sign
of his trust in that person.
I suppose, then, that I'm
at your service. Now...
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
他總是說，他可能會派
帶著那枚硬幣的人來找我，
作為他對那個人信任的標誌。
我想，那麼，我為你服務。
現在...

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
What exactly did you need?
I'm guessing you've come
here to ask me something
about Comodo. As one of the
oldest elders, I know more
about this village than most...
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
你具體需要什麼？
我猜你是來問我
關於克魔島的事情的。
作為最年長的長老之一，
我對這個村莊的瞭解比大多數人...多得多。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, I was hoping
you can tell me about
Comodo Cheese. If it really
exists, I'd like to know
where I can get some.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實，我希望你能告訴我
關於克魔島乳酪的事。
如果它真的存在，
我想知道在哪裡能買到。

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
Oh... That. First of all,
Comodo Cheese does exist,
and it's as precious as the
legends say. However, it's
not a true cheese, although you may think so from its taste.
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
哦...那個。首先，
克魔島乳酪確實存在，
而且像傳說中說的那樣珍貴。
然而，它不是真正的乳酪，
儘管從味道上你可能這麼認為。

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
Yes, it's a very rare, natural
substance and isn't made from
cow or goat milk or anything
like that. However, Comodo
Cheese isn't merely food.
No, it's much more...
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
是的，它是一種非常稀有的天然物質，
不是由牛奶或山羊奶製成的。
然而，克魔島乳酪不僅僅是食物。
不，它更多...

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
Those that eat Comodo
Cheese find that their
true potential is unlocked.
Comodo Cheese's true name
is the ^3355FFAwakening Stone^000000. Now,
doesn't that sound impressive?
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
吃了克魔島乳酪的人
會發現他們的真正潛力被釋放。
克魔島乳酪的真名是
^3355FF覺醒石^000000。
現在，聽起來是不是很厲害？

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
The Awakening Stone is
one of the keys to obtaining
some kind of forbidden power.
That's why only the bravest
adventurers can expect the
chance of ever eating it.
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
覺醒石是獲得某種
禁忌力量的鑰匙之一。
這就是為什麼只有最勇敢的冒險者
才有機會吃到它。

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
Do you really wish to
eat the Comodo Cheese and
see where its power may lead
you? If so, you'll have to endure great challenges to obtain it...
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
你真的想
吃克魔島乳酪，
看看它的力量會把你帶向何方嗎？
如果是這樣，你必須忍受巨大的挑戰才能獲得它...

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
When you've decided
to pursue the Awakening
Stone, seek out a man named
^3355FFNigirboran^000000. He will judge
whether you are worthy
of the Comodo Cheese...
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
當你決定
追求覺醒石時，
去找一個叫^3355FF尼吉爾博蘭^000000的人。
他會判斷你是否
配得上克魔島乳酪...

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
Now, you should be
able to find Nigiroban
training somewhere in one
of Comodo's Dungeon Caves.
I'll send him a message to
let him know you're coming...
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
現在，你應該能在
克魔島的某個地牢洞穴中找到尼吉爾博蘭訓練。
我會給他發訊息，
讓他知道你要來...

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
Love! Love!
Love together~
Love! Love!
Love togeth-hm?
Boy, you're ruining
my groove! Now beat it!
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
愛！愛！
愛在一起~
愛！愛！
愛在一-嗯？
男孩，你毀了我的節奏！
現在滾開！

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
Love! Love!
Love together~
Love! Love!
Love togeth-hm?
Girl, you're ruining
my groove! Get away~
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
愛！愛！
愛在一起~
愛！愛！
愛在一-嗯？
女孩，你毀了我的節奏！
走開~

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
Do you really wish to
eat the Comodo Cheese and
see where its power may lead
you? If so, you'll have to endure great challenges to obtain it...
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
你真的想
吃克魔島乳酪，
看看它的力量會把你帶向何方嗎？
如果是這樣，你必須忍受巨大的挑戰才能獲得它...

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
When you've decided
to pursue the Awakening
Stone, seek out a man named
^3355FFNigirboran^000000. He will judge
whether you are worthy
of the Comodo Cheese...
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
當你決定
追求覺醒石時，
去找一個叫^3355FF尼吉爾博蘭^000000的人。
他會判斷你是否
配得上克魔島乳酪...

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
Now, you should be
able to find Nigiroban
training somewhere in one
of Comodo's Dungeon Caves.
I'll send him a message to
let him know you're coming...
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
現在，你應該能在
克魔島的某個地牢洞穴中找到尼吉爾博蘭訓練。
我會給他發訊息，
讓他知道你要來...

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
Hmm? So you've failed
Nigirboran's test, have
you? Well, you better train
until you can pass it. Otherwise, eating Comodo Cheese could
mean your death, you know.
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
嗯？所以你
沒通過尼吉爾博蘭的測試，是嗎？
好吧，你最好訓練
直到你能通過為止。否則，吃克魔島乳酪
可能意味著你的死亡，你知道嗎。

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
Ah, you've returned.
So were you able to pass
Nigirboran's little test? An
adventurer like you should
be able to have no problem
with it. I've got faith in you~
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
啊，你回來了。
那麼，你通過尼吉爾博蘭的小測試了嗎？
像你這樣的冒險者，應該毫無問題才對。
我對你的信任可是很深的哦~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou present the token that
signifies that you passed
Nigirboran's test to Hullaris.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你將代表通過尼吉爾博蘭測試的令牌
交給了胡拉里斯。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
Ah, I was right after all.
I'm glad to see that you've
proven worthy of eating this
Comodo Cheese, or more
accurately, the Awakening
Stone. Here, let me get it...
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
啊，果然沒錯。
很高興看到你有資格享用這塊克魔島乳酪，
或者更準確地說，是覺醒石。
讓我來取一下...

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
There you are...
Only brave and worthy
adventurers are allowed to
eat this. Understand that
eating Comodo Cheese is
a rare and coveted honor!
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
給你...
只有勇敢且值得的冒險者
才有資格享用它。
請明白，享用克魔島乳酪
是一種罕見且令人嚮往的榮譽！

scripts.text:
^3355FFHullaris carefully
hands you a plate of
Comodo Cheese. You enjoy
the rich, smooth flavor of
each and every morsel...
It's sublimely delicious!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF胡拉里斯小心翼翼地遞給你一盤克魔島乳酪。
你盡情享受著每一口濃郁順滑的美味...
真是極致的美味！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAfter you finish eating the
Comodo Cheese, you feel
a subtle, yet definite energy
gently pulsing through your
body. You feel a powerful, yet
quiet confidence of being able
to accomplish anything.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF吃完克魔島乳酪後，你感覺到一股微妙卻確定的能量
在體內輕輕脈動。你感到一種強大而安靜的自信，
相信自己能夠完成任何事。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
Hahahah! So what
do you think? It's great,
isn't it? It's unreal, how
delicious it is. All other
foods can never match the
quality of Comodo Cheese~
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
哈哈哈哈哈！
你覺得怎麼樣？很棒吧？
簡直不可思議，它太美味了。
其他任何食物都無法與克魔島乳酪的品質相提並論~

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
Now, I know that you probably
have things to do, but might
I suggest that you visit the
town of Al De Baran? There's
a man there that can tell you
about the Slate of Muriniel.
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
現在，我知道你可能還有事要忙，
但我建議你去艾爾帕蘭鎮看看？
那裡有一位男子，
可以告訴你關於穆里尼爾石板的事。

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
You've already eaten the
Awakening Stone, so you may
as well obtain the other things
that you need to earn one of
the three forbidden swords.
It's just a thought...
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
既然你已經吃下了覺醒石，
不妨也去獲取其他
獲得三把禁忌之劍之一所需的物品。
這只是個建議...

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
Ah... Dance.
It's more than just a form
of entertainment. It's art,
it's seduction, it's battle,
and it's love. Only a true
Dancer can understand this...
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
啊...舞蹈。
它不僅僅是娛樂形式。
它是藝術，是誘惑，是戰鬥，
也是愛。只有真正的舞娘才能理解這一點...

scripts.text:
[Hullaris]
You know, Comodo is famous
for its Dance Academy and the
Dancers that have been trained
there. If you know any female
Archers, why don't you suggest
visiting the school to them?
scripts.translation:
[胡拉里斯]
你知道嗎，克魔島以其舞蹈學院
以及在那裡受訓的舞娘而聞名。
如果你認識任何女性弓箭手，
何不建議她們去參觀一下那所學校呢？

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
You're the one that
Hullaris sent? So you're
here to earn the right to
eat the Awakening Stone...
Or Comodo Cheese, as it's
more commonly known.
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
你是胡拉里斯派來的？
所以你是來爭取
吃覺醒石的資格的...
或者用更通俗的說法，是克魔島乳酪。

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
Yes, it has many names...
But it's more than a mere
tasty treat--the Awakening
Stone can help you access
your true potential. But if you're not prepared... then you'll die.
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
是的，它有很多名字...
但它不僅僅是一種美味的小吃——
覺醒石可以幫助你發掘真正的潛力。
但如果你沒有做好準備...那你就會死。

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
If your mind and body
aren't sufficiently trained,
your body will reject the
Comodo Cheese and you
would die a slow, painful,
yet incredibly flavorful death.
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
如果你的身心沒有得到充分的訓練，
你的身體會排斥克魔島乳酪，
你會經歷一種緩慢、痛苦，
卻又無比美味的死亡。

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
But I'm sure that won't
happen to you! If Hullaris
sent you to me, you must
have a fighting chance, right?
So come back when you're
ready for the testing~
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
但我相信那不會發生在你身上！
既然胡拉里斯把你派給我，
你一定有勝算，對吧？
所以，等你準備好接受測試時再回來~

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
Good, you have returned--
I'd expect nothing less of
a brave and daring adventurer.
Now hold still as I gauge your
body's internal energies and see if it can handle Comodo Cheese...
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
很好，你回來了——
我本來也期待一位勇敢大膽的冒險者會如此。
現在請保持靜止，讓我測量你體內的能量，
看看你的身體是否能承受克魔島乳酪...

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
Alright.
Are you ready?
Now... Brace yourself!
Heeeeeyah! Hoooo-HAH!
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
好了。
你準備好了嗎？
現在...做好心理準備！
嘿呀！呼——哈！

scripts.text:
^3355FFA powerful current of
warmth immediately coarses
through your body from head
to toe, and you struggle to
keep yourself from writhing.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF一股強大的暖流瞬間從你的頭頂
流向腳底，你掙扎著
不讓自己扭動身體。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
Hmm... Your body seems
well trained, but your mind
is still reeling from the test.
If you ate the Comodo Cheese
now, you'd be reduced to an
incoherent invalid...
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
嗯...你的身體似乎訓練有素，
但你的精神還在測試中恍惚。
如果你現在吃下克魔島乳酪，
你會變成一個神志不清的廢人...

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
Go and train yourself
a little more, and try
to improve your mind's
sense of clarity. When
you feel ready, come
back to me once more.
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
去再訓練一下自己，
試著提高你精神的清晰度。
當你覺得準備好了，
再來找我一次。

scripts.text:
^3355FFA powerful current of
warmth immediately coarses
through your body from head
to toe, and you struggle to
keep yourself from writhing.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF一股強大的暖流瞬間從你的頭頂
流向腳底，你掙扎著
不讓自己扭動身體。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
Huh. Your body is
strong, but your spirit
is weak. You need more
training. If you were to eat
the Comodo Cheese now...
You would evaporate.
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
嗯。你的身體很強，
但你的精神很弱。你需要更多訓練。
如果你現在吃下克魔島乳酪...
你會直接蒸發掉。

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
But don't lose heart,
it's too early for you
to give up. Go out and
train some more, and then
come back to me when you
feel like you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
但別灰心，
現在放棄還太早了。出去再訓練一下，
等你覺得自己準備好了，
再來找我。

scripts.text:
^3355FFA powerful current of
warmth immediately coarses
through your body from head
to toe, and you struggle to
keep yourself from writhing.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF一股強大的暖流瞬間從你的頭頂
流向腳底，你掙扎著
不讓自己扭動身體。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
Yes... Yes...
Your mind, soul, and body
seem well trained. I think you
can eat the Comodo Cheese
without any ill effect. Good,
good, I think you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
是的...是的...
你的心、靈、身似乎都訓練有素。
我想你可以吃下克魔島乳酪
而不會有任何不良反應。很好，
很好，我想你準備好了。

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
Here, take this little
token to Hullaris. That
will prove to her that
you've passed my little
test. Congratulations~
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
拿著，把這個小信物交給胡拉里斯。
這將向她證明你通過了我的小測試。
恭喜~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've received
a token button to
present to Hullaris
from Nigirboran.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你從尼吉爾博蘭那裡
收到了一枚徽章，
可以出示給胡拉里斯。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
Ah, I almost forgot
to ask you. Why do you
seek the Comodo Cheese,
or the Awakening Stone?
Are you seeking one of
the 3 forbidden swords?
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
啊，我差點忘了問你。
你為什麼尋找克魔島乳酪，
或者覺醒之石？
你是在尋找三把禁忌之劍中的一把嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
I don't know all the details,
but I do know that you'll need
the ^3355FFAwakening Stone^000000, the ^3355FFBook^000000
^3355FFof the Lamb^000000 and the ^3355FFSlate of^000000
^3355FFMurniel^000000 to even have a chance of obtaining one of those swords.
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
雖然我不清楚所有細節，
但我知道，想要有機會獲得那把劍，
你需要^3355FF覺醒之石^000000、^3355FF羔羊^000000
^3355FF之書^000000以及^3355FF穆尼爾^000000
^3355FF石板^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
Let's see... After you
speak to Hullaris, you
should go to Al De Baran
and find someone named
^3355FFMeteurengut^000000 to learn about
the Slate of Muriniel.
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
讓我想想...在你
和胡拉里斯對話之後，
你應該去艾爾帕蘭，
找一個叫^3355FF梅圖倫古特^000000的人，
瞭解關於穆爾尼爾石板的事情。

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
Anyway, I wish you
the best of luck in
accomplishing your
goals. Godspeed...
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
總之，祝你
在實現目標的過程中
好運。一路順風...

scripts.text:
^3355FFA torrent of warmth
coarses through your
entire body, and you
immediately faint from
the rush of energy.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF一股熱流湧過你的
全身，你因能量的衝擊
而立即昏厥過去。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
Goodness...!
Your mind and body
are far too weak to
handle the Comodo Cheese
now. You must seriously
train yourself much more...
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
天哪...！
你的身心太弱了，
現在無法承受克魔島乳酪。
你必須認真進行更多訓練...

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
After you've developed
some more strength, come
back to me. You can retake
this little test anytime~
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
等你再增強一些力量後，
再來找我。你可以隨時
重新參加這個小測試~

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
I don't know all the details,
but I do know that you'll need
the ^3355FFAwakening Stone^000000, the ^3355FFBook^000000
^3355FFof the Lamb^000000 and the ^3355FFSlate of^000000
^3355FFMurniel^000000 to even have a chance
of obtaining a forbidden sword.
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
雖然我不清楚所有細節，
但我知道，想要有機會獲得那把禁忌之劍，
你需要^3355FF覺醒之石^000000、^3355FF羔羊^000000
^3355FF之書^000000以及^3355FF穆尼爾^000000
^3355FF石板^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
Let's see... After you
speak to Hullaris, you
should go to Al De Baran
and find someone named
^3355FFMeteurengut^000000 to learn about
the Slate of Muriniel.
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
讓我想想...在你
和胡拉里斯對話之後，
你應該去艾爾帕蘭，
找一個叫^3355FF梅圖倫古特^000000的人，
瞭解關於穆爾尼爾石板的事情。

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
Anyway, I wish you
the best of luck in
accomplishing your
goals. Godspeed...
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
總之，祝你
在實現目標的過程中
好運。一路順風...

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
Somewhere in ^3355FFAl De Baran^000000,
you'll find a man named
^3355FFMeteurengut^000000. He should be
able to help you learn more
about the Slate of Muriniel.
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
在^3355FF艾爾帕蘭^000000的某個地方，
你會找到一個叫^3355FF梅圖倫古特^000000的男人。
他應該能幫助你瞭解更多
關於穆爾尼爾石板的事情。

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
Oh... Hello there.
I guess you could say
that I'm something of
a trainer here in Comodo.
My name is Nigirboran.
I know it's hard to say...
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
哦...你好。
我想你可以說我是克魔島這裡
的某種訓練師。
我的名字是尼吉爾博蘭。
我知道這很難說出口...

scripts.text:
[Nigirboran]
If Hullaris hasn't sent
you, then I don't think
I can be of any real help
for you. That seems to be
the case, so I'd appreciate
it if you'd let me train...
scripts.translation:
[尼吉爾博蘭]
如果胡拉里斯沒有派你來，
我想我可能幫不了你什麼忙。
看來情況就是這樣，
如果你能讓我訓練一下...

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
Ah. Your body is surrounded
by the glow of one that has
eaten of the Awakening Stone.
That alone may prove your value
as an adventurer, but are you
free from your selfish desires?
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
啊。你的身體被吃過覺醒之石之人的
光芒所環繞。
僅此一點或許能證明你作為冒險者的價值，
但你是否擺脫了自私的慾望？

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
Even just the smallest
taint of greed or jealousy
can prove to be a corruptive
influence when power is not
tempered by wisdom and a
sense of true compassion.
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
即使是最微小的貪婪或嫉妒的汙點，
當力量不被智慧和真正的慈悲所
約束時，也會成為腐蝕性的影響。

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
Others like you have come
before me in hopes of learning
about the Slate of Muriniel and
eventually obtaining one of the
three accursed blades. You are probably no different from them...
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
像你的人之前也來過我這裡，
希望能瞭解穆爾尼爾石板，
並最終獲得三把被詛咒的劍之一。你大概和他們沒什麼不同...

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
The Slate of Muriniel is an
alchemic artifact that can
help one access unimaginable
power, originally developed
by a master of alchemy that was
known as Rikaseh Sumarecon.
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
穆爾尼爾石板是一件鍊金製品，
可以幫助人獲得難以想像的
力量，最初是由一位被稱為
裡卡塞·蘇馬雷孔的鍊金大師開發的。

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
Sumarecon had two apprentices,
and after he had passed down the secrets of the Slate of Muriniel
to only one of his proteges, his other protege killed him and the
other student out of jealousy.
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
蘇馬雷孔有兩名學徒，
在他將穆爾尼爾石板的秘密
只傳授給其中一人後，
另一名學徒出於嫉妒，
殺死了他和那位同學。

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
Sumarecon's secrets were
thought to be lost forever...
Fortunately, years later, an
Alchemist named Kuprite found
Sumarecon's secret documents
containing his knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
蘇馬雷孔的秘密
一度被認為永遠失傳了...
幸運的是，多年以後，
一位名叫庫普萊特的鍊金術士
發現了蘇馬雷孔的
秘密檔案，其中記載著他的知識。

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
Kuprite then taught these
secrets to a select group of
Alchemy students, one of which
was my ancestor, Burukesaemu.
And so, because of my lineage,
I have learned those secrets.
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
庫普萊特隨後將這些秘密
傳授給了一小群鍊金術士學生，
其中一位就是我的祖先，
布魯克薩姆。
因此，憑藉我的血統，
我得以習得這些秘密。

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
If you wish for me to
reproduce the Slate of
Muriniel for you, then
please bring me the items
I require to complete the
secret alchemic procedure.
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
如果你希望我為你
複製穆爾尼爾石板，
請帶來我完成
這一秘密鍊金程式
所需的材料。

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
I shall need
^3355FF1 Sapphire^000000,
^3355FF1 Shining Stone^000000,
^3355FF1 Rough Elunium^000000,
^3355FF1 Emerald^000000, and
^3355FF1 Blue Gemstone^000000.

[Meteurengut]
You've already found
all of the items I require to
create the Slate of Muriniel?
Fantastic. Now I can begin work
on this. However, there is one
more thing I must ask of you.
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
你已經找到了
我製作穆爾尼爾石板
所需的所有材料？
太好了。現在我可以開始工作了。
不過，還有一件事
需要拜託你。

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
Would you please bring me
^3355FF1 Cobweb^000000? You can obtain
them by slaying spiders in
Muriniel Pass which is on the
way to Al De Baran from here.
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
請幫我帶一些
^3355FF1蜘蛛網^000000來。你可以在
前往艾爾帕蘭途中的
穆爾尼爾峽谷裡
通過擊殺蜘蛛獲得。

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
I'd have asked for it
sooner, but I need to prepare
all of these stones, and I need
the freshest Cobwebs I can get.
I'll make sure that these stones are ready when you return.
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
我本想早點要，
但我需要先準備好這些礦石，
而且我需要最新鮮的蜘蛛網。
等你回來時，
我會確保這些礦石已經準備好了。

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
If you wish for me to
reproduce the Slate of
Muriniel for you, then
please bring me the items
I require to complete the
secret alchemic procedure.
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
如果你希望我為你
複製穆爾尼爾石板，
請帶來我完成
這一秘密鍊金程式
所需的材料。

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
I shall need
^3355FF1 Sapphire^000000,
^3355FF1 Shining Stone^000000,
^3355FF1 Rough Elunium^000000,
^3355FF1 Emerald^000000, and
^3355FF1 Blue Gemstone^000000.

[Meteurengut]
I see that you've brought
me a Cobweb. It's hard to
believe, but it's integreal to
creating the Slate of Muriniel.
Now, if you'll wait a moment,
I shall complete the slate...
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
看來你帶蜘蛛網來了。
雖然難以置信，
但它對製作穆爾尼爾石板
至關重要。
現在，請稍等片刻，
我將完成石板...

scripts.text:
*^3355FFClang Clang Clang!*
*Zaaaaaaaaaaaaaap*
*Ching tink t-t-t-tap*^000000
scripts.translation:
*^3355FF叮噹 叮噹 叮噹！*
*滋啦啦啦*
*叮叮 叮叮 叮叮 叮*^000000

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
*Whew* It's finished.
Please take care of this
slate, and know that I am
entrusting you with an artifact
that can help you access power
beyond your imagination...
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
*呼* 完成了。
請妥善保管這塊石板，
要知道，我託付給你的是一件
能幫助你獲得超越想像之力的
神器...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have received
the Slate of Muriniel.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你獲得了
穆爾尼爾石板。^000000

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
There. You have eaten of
the Awakening Stone and you
possess the Slate of Muriniel.
Now, you must try to obtain the
^3355FFBook of the Lamb^000000 if you are
questing for a doomed sword...
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
好了。你吃過覺醒之石，
並且擁有了穆爾尼爾石板。
現在，如果你正在尋找
一把註定悲劇的劍，
你必須設法獲得
^3355FF羔羊之書^000000...

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
I know very little about
that artifact, and its secrets
are as well guarded as that of
the Slate of Muriniel. However,
I do know that a man in Morocc can create the Book of the Lamb...
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
我對那件神器知之甚少，
它的秘密也像穆爾尼爾石板
一樣被嚴密守護著。不過，
我知道摩洛哥有一位男子
可以製作羔羊之書...

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
If that man is still in
Morocc, then he will probably
recognize the subtle emanation
of the Awakening Stone and the
Slate of Muriniel from you. Best of luck to you, adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
如果那位男子還在摩洛哥，
他大概能認出你身上
覺醒之石和穆爾尼爾石板
散發出的微弱氣息。
祝你好運，冒險者...

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
Ah, have you brought a
Cobweb? I know it sounds
strange, but I really need the
unique energy found only in
fresh Cobwebs to finish the
Slate of Muriniel for you...
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
啊，你帶蜘蛛網來了？
我知道這聽起來很奇怪，
但我確實需要只有新鮮蜘蛛網
才有的獨特能量，
才能為你完成穆爾尼爾石板...

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
You've eaten of the
Awakening Stone and
now possess the Slate of
Muriniel. Now, all you must
do is obtain the Book of the
Lamb. I know little about it...
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
你吃過覺醒之石，
現在擁有了穆爾尼爾石板。
現在，你只需要
獲得羔羊之書即可。
我對它知之甚少...

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
All I can tell you is that
there should be a man in
Morocc that can create it
for you. A man like that can
sense the Slate of Muriniel,
so he may call out to you...
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
我能告訴你的只有，
摩洛哥應該有一位男子
可以為你製作它。
那樣的人能感知到穆爾尼爾石板，
所以他可能會呼喚你...

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
The ^3355FFSlate of Muriniel^000000
is an ancient artifact
that can only be created
by the power of Alchemy.
It is one of the best kept
secrets of my family...
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
^3355FF穆爾尼爾石板^000000
是一件古代神器，
只能通過鍊金術的力量
製作而成。
它是我家族
最保守的秘密之一...

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
I'm responsible for guarding
the secrets of its creation, but I must also share the power
of the slate with those that
prove themselves worthy of it.
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
我負責守護
製作它的秘密，
但我必須也將石板的力量
分享給那些
證明自己配得上它的人。

scripts.text:
[Meteurengut]
After all, power is useless
if it is never used. However,
if power is never balanced with
wisdom and compassion, then
it will inevitably do more harm
than good in the very end...
scripts.translation:
[梅圖倫古特]
畢竟，力量若從未被使用，便毫無意義。
然而，若力量從未與智慧和慈悲相平衡，
最終它帶來的傷害必將多於益處...

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
...You there! Hold it!
Yes, I can feel it from
you... The power of the
Awakening Stone... And...
The Slate of Muriniel?
Finally, you've come.
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
...喂，那邊那個！站住！
是的，我能感覺到...
來自你身上的覺醒之石的力量...
還有...
穆爾尼爾石板？
終於，你來了。

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
I'm fully aware that only
those that seek to own one
of the doomed swords would
trouble themselve to obtain
those items. All that is left for you is the Book of the Lamb...
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
我完全清楚，只有那些
渴望擁有詛咒之劍的人，
才會費心去獲取那些物品。
對你來說，剩下的只有羔羊之書了...

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
I've been waiting for so
long for the opportunity to
create the Book of the Lamb.
If you really want the book,
I will help you so long as
you will help me.
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
我等待制造羔羊之書的機會
已經很久了。
如果你真的想要這本書，
只要你肯幫我，我就幫你。

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
However, creating the book
is a complicated process and
requires multiple stages of
preparation. Therefore, I shall
ask you to bring me the items
I require in separate batches.
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
不過，製造這本書的過程很複雜，
需要分多個階段準備。
因此，我會分批次
讓你帶給我所需的物品。

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
Alright...
What was it now?
Ah, yes. The first thing
I need is ^3355FF2 Snake Scales^000000,
so please bring those soon.
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
好的...
剛才是什麼來著？
啊，對了。我首先需要的
是^3355FF2 蛇鱗^000000，
請儘快帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
Ah, you've brought
the Snake Scales? Good,
let me take them now and
begin work on the Book of
the Lamb. Now, I need you
to bring me ^3355FF1 Scale Shell^000000.
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
啊，你帶蛇鱗來了？很好，
先讓我收下，
開始製作羔羊之書。
現在，我需要你
帶給我^3355FF1 鱗片皮膚^000000。

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
I know it would be more
convenient for you if I told
you everything I needed at
once, but actually, this way
is much more convenient for
me. I'll be waiting right here!
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
我知道如果我一次性
告訴你所有需要的東西，
對你來說更方便，
但實際上，這樣對我更方便。
我會在這裡等著！

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
The first thing I'll
need to begin creating
the Book of the Lamb is
^3355FF2 Snake Scales^000000. Come back
to me once you get them,
alright? I'll be right here.
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
開始製作羔羊之書，
我首先需要的
是^3355FF2 蛇鱗^000000。
拿到後回來找我，好嗎？
我就在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
Oh, nice! You've brought
this Scale Shell for me,
right? Great, great, this will
help enhance the book's
physical durability, but it
still needs magic durability...
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
哦，不錯！你帶這個
鱗片皮膚給我了，對吧？
很好，很好，這有助於
增強書的物理耐久性，
但它還需要魔法耐久性...

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
Next, you need to bring
me ^3355FF1 Shining Shell^000000. Hurry
and bring you to me before
I finish this part of the process, okay? Wait, actually, I think
you can take your time...
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
接下來，你需要帶給我
^3355FF1 發亮鱗片^000000。在我完成這一部分
工序之前，趕緊帶給我，好嗎？
等等，其實，你可以慢慢來...

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
I'll be waiting right
here while you go and
look for a ^3355FFScale Shell^000000
that you can bring to me.
I'll need that in order to
finish this Book of the Lamb.
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
我會在這裡等著，
你去尋找一個^3355FF鱗片皮膚^000000
帶給我。
我需要它才能
完成這本羔羊之書。

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
Ah, you're just in time!
Have you got the Shining
Scale? Perfect. Now, there
is just one more item that
I want to ask you to bring me:
^3355FF1 Stinky Scale^000000. Easy, right?
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
啊，你來得正是時候！
你帶發亮鱗片來了嗎？
完美。現在，還有最後一件物品
我想請你帶給我：
^3355FF1 腐爛鱗片^000000。很簡單，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
The energy of a Stinky
Scale can be used to
regulate the power of
incredibly potent artifacts.
Without that item, the Book
of the Lamb isn't much use...
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
腐爛鱗片的能量可以用來
調節極其強大的神器之力。
沒有那個物品，羔羊之書
就沒多大用處了...

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
If you want me to
finish this Book of
the Lamb, you need
to come back here with
^3355FF1 Shining Scale^000000. There's
no way to work around it...
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
如果你想讓我
完成這本羔羊之書，
你需要帶著^3355FF1 發亮鱗片^000000
回到這裡。沒有別的辦法...

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
What's that sme--?
Oh, right. I asked you to
bring me a Stinky Scale.
Now I can finally complete
this Book of the Lamb! I've
been looking forward to this...
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
那是什麼臭--？
哦，對了。我讓你
帶給我腐爛鱗片。
現在我終於可以
完成這本羔羊之書了！
我一直很期待這一刻...

scripts.text:
^3355FFZaka completes
the creation of the
Book of the Lamb.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF扎卡完成了
羔羊之書的製造。^000000

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
What...?!
That's it? Well, um,
it's done. That felt
rather anticlimatic, but
I can finally see this
thing with my own eyes!
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
什麼...？！
就這樣？嗯，
完成了。感覺有點
缺乏高潮，但我終於
能親眼看到這東西了！

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
Alright, you've eaten of the
Awakening Stone, obtained the
Slate of Muriniel, and now have
the Book of the Lamb. You're
getting very close to owning
one of the doomed swords.
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
好了，你吃過覺醒之石，
獲得了穆爾尼爾石板，
現在又有了羔羊之書。
你離擁有詛咒之劍
已經非常接近了。

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
There is man that you
must find in Comodo named
^3355FFWon^000000. He will judge you, and
then give you the proof that
shows you are qualified to
be a doomed sword bearer.
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
在克魔島，
你必須找到一位名叫
^3355FF元^000000的男子。
他會審判你，
然後給你證明，
表明你有資格
成為詛咒之劍的持有者。

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
He looks like a simple
man, but he is a true living
legend renown for his wisdom.
If you really want a doomed
sword, you need to speak to
Won and ask him to guide you.
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
他看起來只是個普通人，
但他是一位真正的傳奇，
以智慧聞名於世。
如果你真的想要詛咒之劍，
你需要去找元，
請他指引你。

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
The last thing that I need
to complete the Book of the
Lamb is ^3355FF1 Stinky Scale^000000. Please
bring that to me as soon as
you can. Thank you for being
patient, young adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
完成羔羊之書，
我還需要^3355FF1個腐爛鱗片^000000。
請儘快把它帶給我。
謝謝你的耐心，年輕的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
Now, you need to visit a
man named ^3355FFWon^000000 in Comodo
in order to get the proof that
shows that you're qualified to
possess a doomed sword.
Hopefully, you'll get it...
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
現在，你需要去克魔島
找一位名叫^3355FF元^000000的男子，
以獲得證明你有資格
擁有詛咒之劍的信物。
希望你能順利拿到...

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
Have you heard that swords
with the power to change the
world actually exist? It's true
that three swords contain this
immense power, but they are
also bound to powerful curses.
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
你聽說過擁有改變世界
力量的劍嗎？
確實有三把劍蘊含著
這種巨大的力量，
但它們同時也伴隨著
強大的詛咒。

scripts.text:
[Zaka]
Therefore, the Mysteltainn,
Ogretooth, and Executioner
have all been sealed away.
Only a truly great adventurer
can release these doomed swords and actually wield them...
scripts.translation:
[扎卡]
因此，妖劍 弒光、
行刑者和獸牙怪
都被封印了起來。
只有真正偉大的冒險者
才能釋放這些詛咒之劍
並揮舞它們...

scripts.text:
[Won]
Hmm...? It's been a while
since someone came here to
get the qualification to own a
doomed sword. Yeah, I know
that's why you're here...
scripts.translation:
[元]
嗯...？
已經很久沒有人來
這裡獲取擁有詛咒之劍
的資格了。
沒錯，我知道你來這裡的原因...

scripts.text:
[Won]
To a man like me, the
presenses of the Book of the
Lamb, the Slate of Muriniel,
and one that has eaten of the
Awakening Stone are unmistakable.
scripts.translation:
[元]
對於像我這樣的人來說，
羔羊之書、穆爾尼爾石板
以及吃過覺醒之石的人
的氣息是 unmistakable 的。

scripts.text:
[Won]
Now, listen. I personally
don't care why you want a
doomed sword. If you abuse
its power, you'll pay the price
eventually. I'm only here to
make sure you're up to snuff.
scripts.translation:
[元]
聽著。我個人並不關心
你為什麼想要詛咒之劍。
如果你濫用它的力量，
最終你會付出代價。
我只負責確認你是否合格。

scripts.text:
[Won]
Of course, I also want to
make sure that you don't bring
great suffering to the world
using a doomed sword. So I'm
going to check if you're, you
know, balanced and all that.
scripts.translation:
[元]
當然，我也希望確保
你不會使用詛咒之劍
給世界帶來巨大的痛苦。
所以我要檢查一下
你是否，你知道的，
心態平衡之類的。

scripts.text:
[Won]
Alright, let me take
a look into your eyes...
Yeah, alright. You seem to
understand the value of the
Awakening Stone, Book of the Lamb, and the Slate of Muriniel.
scripts.translation:
[元]
好了，讓我看看你的眼睛...
嗯，不錯。
你似乎理解覺醒之石、
羔羊之書和穆爾尼爾石板
的價值。

scripts.text:
[Won]
Yeah, I can't sense any
ill intent from you at all.
That's very good. Huh, you
seem pretty experienced in battle, so I'm sure you have the stamina
to handle to a doomed sword...
scripts.translation:
[元]
是的，我完全感覺不到
你有任何惡意。
這很好。嗯，
你看起來戰鬥經驗很豐富，
我相信你有足夠的體力
來駕馭詛咒之劍...

scripts.text:
[Won]
Ah, but most importantly,
you don't strike me as crazy
at all. Alright, we're done here. Take this Stamp of Muriniel:
it's the official qualification
token to own a doomed sword.
scripts.translation:
[元]
啊，但最重要的是，
你看起來一點也不瘋狂。
好了，我們結束了。
拿著這個穆爾尼爾印章：
它是擁有詛咒之劍的
官方資格信物。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou receive the
Stamp of Muriniel.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你獲得了
穆爾尼爾印章。^000000

scripts.text:
[Won]
Mysteltainn, Executioner,
and Ogretooth... These are
the forbidden blades, the
doomed swords. Remember
that you cannot choose
which weapon you'll wield...
scripts.translation:
[元]
妖劍 弒光、行刑者
和獸牙怪...
這些是禁忌之刃，
也就是詛咒之劍。
記住，你不能選擇
你要揮舞哪把武器...

scripts.text:
[Won]
These swords have a will
of their own. The doomed
sword that finds you most
worthy of it will choose you.
You can understand that, right?
scripts.translation:
[元]
這些劍有自己的意志。
那把認為你最配得上它的
詛咒之劍會選擇你。
你能理解這一點，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Won]
Now that you have this
qualification, I'm supposed
to direct you to the Sages
that can help lead you to
the doomed swords.
scripts.translation:
[元]
既然你有了這個資格，
我應該指引你去見
那些能幫助你找到
詛咒之劍的賢者。

scripts.text:
[Won]
The first Sage that you
must visit is ^3355FFSage Yklah^000000
in the city of ^3355FFJuno^000000 in the
Schwarzwald Republic.
Your quest to obtain a
doomed sword isn't over yet...
scripts.translation:
[元]
你必須拜訪的第一位賢者是
位於修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國
^3355FF朱諾^000000城的
^3355FF賢者伊克拉^000000。
你獲取詛咒之劍的旅程
還沒有結束...

scripts.text:
[Won]
Now that you have this
qualification, I'm supposed
to direct you to the Sages
that can help lead you to
the doomed swords.
scripts.translation:
[元]
既然你有了這個資格，
我應該指引你去見
那些能幫助你找到
詛咒之劍的賢者。

scripts.text:
[Won]
The first Sage that you
must visit is ^3355FFSage Yklah^000000
in the city of ^3355FFJuno^000000 in the
Schwarzwald Republic.
Your quest to obtain a
doomed sword isn't over yet...
scripts.translation:
[元]
你必須拜訪的第一位賢者是
位於修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國
^3355FF朱諾^000000城的
^3355FF賢者伊克拉^000000。
你獲取詛咒之劍的旅程
還沒有結束...

scripts.text:
[Won]
The visitors and even the
people that live here always
seem to be having such a good
time, just lounging in leisure.
It's hard to believe the War
of the Witch even happened...
scripts.translation:
[元]
這裡的訪客，甚至
住在這裡的人，
似乎總是玩得很開心，
悠閒地放鬆著。
很難相信這裡
發生過魔女戰爭...

scripts.text:
[Won]
But not everyone here in
Comodo can afford to relax
so easily. I, for one, have
the responsibility of seeking
out those that are worthy of, well, I don't know if I can say...
scripts.translation:
[元]
但並非克魔島的每個人
都能如此輕鬆地放鬆。
比如我，就有責任
尋找那些有資格的人，
嗯，我不知道我能不能說...

scripts.text:
[Won]
You just have to
trust that I've got an
incredibly important
job to do. I mean, sure,
it doesn't look like I'm doing
anything right now, but...
scripts.translation:
[元]
你只需要相信我有一份
極其重要的工作要做。
我是說，沒錯，
我現在看起來確實什麼也沒做，
但是...
